title: Don't log-and-return an error the caller will log again
answers: why is the same token/connection error logged twice
duplicate log lines for repository reconcile failures
body: Symptom: the same repository reconcile error (e.g. connection retrieval, token generation, applying status patches) shows up twice in logs. Root cause: RepositoryController.process (pkg/registry/apis/provisioning/controller/repository.go) called logger.Error at the failure site and then returned/propagated the same error, which the repository controller logs again (controller/repository.go, per review comment referencing that double-log path). Fix pattern: when an error path returns err up to the caller, drop the local logger.Error call; only log locally (logger.Warn) on paths that swallow the error and return nil, since those never reach the caller's log statement. Constraints: applies only inside process()'s error paths — do not remove logging on paths that return nil (swallowed/user-caused errors), those must still log locally or the failure becomes invisible.
